scope: Read-only canonical requirements and source review; no provider status, authentication, controller, task, token, credential or workflow operations

findings.finding: Universal twelve-profile authentication is a commissioning helper policy
findings.evidence: validate_auth requires both provider summaries and six successful native profile receipts each before task start; run calls it before state preflight.

findings.finding: Six identities and four shared execution slots are separate constraints
findings.evidence: PLAN-002 immutable chapter ownership requires the existing six configured chapter identities; four remains the shared concurrency ceiling.

findings.finding: Actual inference still requires the chosen worker/provider subscription session
findings.evidence: Installed worker.run checks native integration and inference-only capabilities, launches the selected worker subscription status command and rejects unverified status before inference (worker.py 745-811).

findings.finding: Auth unavailability uses canonical routing holds and fallback
findings.evidence: ROUTE-002/004 require auth-aware candidate advancement and durable holds. routing_store.py 586+ defaults auth failures to provider quota-pool holds, advances the candidate and backs off after exhaustion.
findings.practical_limit: One unavailable profile may impose a pool cooldown affecting other workers; targeted readiness remains operationally useful.

findings.finding: Controller construction has no universal session-validation requirement
findings.evidence: Runtime.__init__ establishes system isolation, hardware, knowledge and stores; tick uses normal admission/routing. It does not validate all twelve CLI sessions before the control plane exists.

findings.finding: Full workflow acceptance is not implied by controller bootstrap
findings.evidence: DEPLOY-001 requires actual account-login preflight; ROUTE-005 independently reviewed outputs exclude the producing provider/model. With the Agy integration hold, an additional eligible provider route remains necessary for those actual workflows.

owner_interaction.mandatory_for_inference: Valid subscription authentication for the provider selected on the isolated identity that executes the job; no copied owner credentials or substituted shared identity.
owner_interaction.actual_new_login_prompt_count: Unknown until status validation; already-valid sessions require no login.

possible_successor.approach: A separately reviewed controller bootstrap could retain every custody, state preservation, six-worker exclusion, exact task and one-start proof while leaving authentication as an explicit per-dispatch readiness state. Do not claim authenticated profile count without evidence.
required_cross_review: Frozen downstream startup-receipt and observer bindings
Login helpers require stopped daemons; startup must not make later authentication unusable
No automatic progression to model acceptance from controller-only success
Fresh or preserved job-state scope and absence of unsolicited submissions
Full usable pipeline goal still requires actual eligible provider sessions and independent review workflows
